warnings: Grid bubbles are printed on this set (สปช. 103/26): numbers 1-7 and letters A, B, C. Numbers are the x axis and letters the y axis (spec §4 rule 4: numbers → x, letters → y). On the sheets the building's long axis (grids 1-7, 6 bays x 4.50 = 27.00) runs up the page and A-B-C run across it; pos_m simply increases with the printed label, origin A1.

Rows A and B carry the column/footing lines (classroom block, A-B 6.50). Row C (2.00 beyond B) is the outer edge of the corridor (ระเบียงทางเดิน): no footings on C — the corridor is carried by the cantilever beams B3' — but the floor/roof plans draw small post squares on C (steel corridor posts, section A-A: 'เสาเหล็ก LG Ø 3"x3" หรือ Ø3" ภายในกรอกคอนกรีตให้เต็ม').

A''/A''' (2.167/4.333) are the two intermediate floor beams B2 between rows A and B on the beam plan S-02. No dimension tick is printed to them on any plan; their position comes from the slab detail S2 printed 'L=6.50/3' together with the plan dividing every A-B bay into three equal S2 strips (also measured off the plan: about 2.16 / 2.21 / 2.14 m — equal thirds within scan distortion). Per-line confidence lowered.

Stair dummies: the floor plan dimensions each corridor stair 2.50 along x from grid 1 (1'') and back from grid 7 (6'), and 0.90 + 1.00 beyond row C (C' = treads end, C''' = landing edge). The roof eave 1.60 beyond C falls between them (C'' = 10.10); all three are separate printed points.

z: 'ระดับหัวเสา' printed on the truss details is the same support level as '+4.40 ระดับหลังคานหลังคา' on the sections/elevations, and 'ระดับดินเดิม' on the footing details is the same ground line as '+0.00 ระดับพื้นดิน' — one z level each, the alias is recorded in the level note. The ridge level is printed only as '~1.35' above the column head, so ระดับสันหลังคา (5.75) carries a lowered score.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-08 and S-10 (pages 17-24, 26), the floor plan (page 05), elevations 1-4 (pages 07-08) and sections A-A / B-B (pages 09-10). Not swept: page 06 roof plan (architectural, prints only the same 1.00 / 1.60 overhangs as S-03), pages 11-16 (stair/door/window/blackboard/wall details — element-internal), page 25 (S-09 truss connection details), page 27 (S-11 timber connections) and page 28 (electrical). Element-internal dimensions of footings, beams, slabs and the stair stay on their elements.
Scanned government set (กลุ่มออกแบบและก่อสร้าง สำนักอำนวยการ สพฐ., แบบ สปช. 103/26, ลงวันที่ 6 มิ.ย. 2551); every value was read off zoomed crops of the page images.
